verdict.rationale: Logseq's own docs say you can type `(())` to reference a block on any page, so referencing an individual block from another note is a first-party capability. The pack does not document embedding or transclusion, does not say edits propagate between source and reference, and does not cover sections or headings. Missing for 10: documentation of block/page embeds (transclusion), explicit evidence that referenced content stays in sync when edited, section-level referencing, independent hands-on corroboration.
